long: Roketz is a 1996 gravity-based cave-flying game in the tradition of Thrust and Gravity Force. Players pilot a rocket through tight, physics-driven caverns, managing momentum and fuel while fighting enemies. It includes a two-player split-screen versus mode for head-to-head dogfights.
name: Roketz
